title: 1620 Prairie stands as tall as its 1874 engraving
items: The Robert Law house is 2.7 m taller. The engraving had been read from an eye below the street; read again from the street fence's foot, it shows a principal floor 2 m up and a cornice at 10.9 m.
Its two storeys are now 4.8 and 4.1 m, with the engraving's long windows, and the porch, stoop and pavilion are raised with them.
The window sills and the bay window's height are still liberties.
